Maria G (Finance): FYI — Feb invoice for Acme (cust_4321) generated with a negative subtotal (-$120.00) and tax lines missing. Invoice ID INV-2026-0142. Found this during reconciliation after the pricing experiment merge.
Aj Patel: tagging @Ben and @billing-bot. Is this coming from the pricing flags job?
Ben C (Billing): On it. Can you paste the CSV row or a snippet?
Maria G (Finance): here's the row I exported from the run: ```invoice_id,customer_id,description,quantity,unit_price,subtotal,tax,total
INV-2026-0142,4321,Reserved capacity (Feb),1,-120.00,-120.00,, -120.00```
billing-bot: billing-run-20260215 completed with warnings: [WRN-43] negative unit_price for product 'reserved-capacity:plan-enterprise' for customer 4321. stack: pick_price_from_experiment -> apply_prorate -> emit_lineitem
Ben C (Billing): That looks like a sign handling bug from the pricing experiment. The experiment override appears to have been applied as a negative unit price instead of a credit. Which experiment ID?
Maria G (Finance): /experiments/pricing/earlybird-2026-02 - the payload had promotion_amount set as -120 (meant to be a $120 credit). The billing code interpreted promotion_amount as unit_price delta. I issued a temporary manual credit to Acme to fix cashflow, but we need a root fix and a full re-run for affected customers.
Aj Patel: running quick impact query: `SELECT count(*) FROM invoice_line_items WHERE run_ts >= '2026-02-01' AND experiment_tag='pricing/earlybird' AND subtotal < 0;` will report back in a few mins.
Ben C (Billing): If count < 50 we can regenerate and reissue in batch; if > 50 we should consider rolling back the experiment config and doing staged fixes. Also open an incident for finance ops and loop in legal/CS for communications.
Kira (Customer Success): I've pinged Acme and told them we're investigating. They want ETA and whether any customer data was exposed. No PII in invoices but amounts are sensitive.
SRE-Ops: Heads-up — the re-run will require a short pause on billing ingestion (15m). When do you want to schedule?
Maria G (Finance): Prefer ASAP to stop cascading. I opened BILL-3124 with the manual credit and reconciliation notes: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-3124
Aj Patel: patch incoming in branch fix/experiment-sign-parse. Will add an assertion for promotion sign handling and a unit test. ETA ~25m to push and coordinate re-run.
Ben C (Billing): Also add a regression: disallow emitting lineitems with unit_price < 0 unless it's explicitly flagged as a credit_line. And add a sanity check in CSV exporter to detect empty tax cells.
Maria G (Finance): Good call. I've documented the mitigations in the ticket. :thumbsup:
billing-bot: re-run started at 1797778988; will post results and any follow-ups.
Maria G (Finance): Thanks all — please update the ticket with the re-run result and affected customer list, and cc Kira for customer comms.
